gloss: make-ahead side dish; prepared dish kept on hand

definitions.gloss: make-ahead side dish; prepared dish kept on hand
definitions.explanation: Side dishes prepared in advance and stored in the refrigerator for several days. A practical approach to meal preparation, allowing busy people to have ready-made side dishes throughout the week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{常備菜|じょうびさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I make prepared side dishes on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {常備菜|じょうびさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧{作|づく}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}になる→楽になる：26083_rakuninaru⟧。
examples.english: Having make-ahead dishes makes daily bento preparation easier.

examples.japanese: ⟦きんぴら→きんぴら：08538_kinpira⟧ごぼうや⟦ひじき→ひじき：07971_hijiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{常備菜|じょうびさい}だ。
examples.english: Kinpira gobo and simmered hijiki are classic make-ahead side dishes.

notes: Composed of ⟦{常備|じょうび}→常備：27113_joubi⟧ (always keeping on hand) + {菜|さい} (dish, vegetable). A key concept in Japanese home cooking (⟦{家庭料理|かていりょうり}→家庭料理：17474_kateiryouri⟧). Typical {常備菜|じょうびさい} include ⟦{切|き}り{干|ぼ}し{大根|だいこん}→切り干し大根：08093_kiriboshidaikon⟧ (dried daikon strips), ⟦きんぴら→きんぴら：08538_kinpira⟧ごぼう (braised burdock), and {煮豆|にまめ} (simmered beans). {常備菜|じょうびさい} recipes have become extremely popular online and in cookbooks, especially among working parents. Also called ⟦{作|つく}り{置|お}き→作り置き：08345_tsukurioki⟧ (meal prep).
